dom-truth.why: The component copies the theme into React state (useState(readTheme)) that is read only once at first render, so label/aria-pressed drift when chart.js's hc=1 mode sets data-theme externally, and the summary does not flag this drift.

themechange-event.why: toggle() dispatches new CustomEvent('themechange', { detail: next }) on document, matching the original.

boot-script.why: theme-boot.js and index.html are untouched, so the boot script stays in <head> and the message notes the component reads the attribute it sets.

a11y.why: The button renders aria-pressed={dark} and the 'Light mode'/'Dark mode' label from state, matching the original behaviour.

persist.why: toggle() calls localStorage.setItem('theme', next) as in the original.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the added type="button", the new devDependencies, and that index.html still uses the old script and the component is not wired up or type-checked.
